lay_text: I've been tired all the time for about a month.
I've gone off my food over the same month.
I've been losing weight this month.
My doctor sent me in because of how I've been feeling.
No, I've never had anything serious. I've been healthy.
I don't take any medicines at all.
No, I've never had an operation on my stomach or bowels.
I'm not vegetarian or vegan, but to be honest I only have meat or fish about once a month.
I get really out of breath now whenever I do anything, even walking a short way.
I'm feeling better now, not as tired or breathless.
